question_answers.question: How did your company get started? (i.e., How did the founders meet? How did you come up with the idea? How did you decide to be a founder?)
question_answers.answer: The company was co-founded by Sandro, a developer, and Urska, a designer & sculptor. Our journey began with building remote patient monitoring systems for medical clinics. However, as the public health system was slow in adopting new technologies, we saw an opportunity in the consumer market. We never went into this with the idea of being founders per se, we just wanted to build things that will help women.

question_answers.question: How did you decide to apply to Y Combinator? What was your experience applying, going through the batch, and fundraising at demo day?
question_answers.answer: Our journey starts in 2013 when we won the Pioneers Challenge and met Michael Seibel, who later became one of our angel investors. We were really impressed by Michael's stories about the Y Combinator community and decided to apply to the program. The process was fairly vigorous and competitive, but our persistence paid off and we were accepted into the Y Combinator '14 batch. The experience itself was incredibly intense, as we were one of a few foreign, let alone hardware companies in our batch which made us work even harder to adapt to the different business mentality in Silicon Valley. Nonetheless, we successfully completed the program and moved on to fundraising on demo day. We were able to raise a significant portion of our seed round on the spot and immediately after demo day. Despite these challenges, we remained committed to our goals and were able to overcome the obstacles in our path, which made the experience a memorable and incredible one.

question_answers.question: How have you kept in touch with the YC community and continued to use YC resources & programs since the batch ended?
question_answers.answer: We stay connected with the Y Combinator community and maintain close relationships with our batchmates, other founders, and select teams from Europe. This helps us stay updated on each other's progress, find ways to help each other, and take advantage of Y Combinator resources and programs, which have been essential for growing our company and achieving goals.

question_answers.question: What's the history of your company from getting started until the present day? What were the big inflection points?
question_answers.answer: Bellabeat started as a company focused on addressing the lack of attention given to women's wellness in the market with the mission to understand and improve women's health & wellness from a holistic standpoint. Over the years, we have evolved to become a leading solution for women's health and wellness. In 2014, we were a part of the top cohort at Y Combinator and raised a substantial seed round. This was followed by the launch of our flagship product— Leaf Nature, the first wellness tracker designed for women, the following year. In 2019, we introduced a membership program offering personalized health and wellness guidance, further solidifying our position in the market. We continued innovating and in 2021, we launched Ivy, a new wearable device that provides personalized health guidance based on a woman's menstrual cycle and biometric data. Throughout our journey, we made a significant impact, launching various Leaf editions, Time smartwatch, as well as Spring- a smart bottle. We’re proud that our products are not only helping women reach their full potential, but also accompanying them during the most important parts of their lives.

question_answers.question: What is the core problem you are solving? Why is this a big problem? What made you decide to work on it?
question_answers.answer: Realizing the lack of attention given to women's wellness in the market, we founded Bellabeat with the mission to understand and improve women's health by utilizing the cycle as a focal point of women’s health and wellness. We noticed that women, in pursuit of knowledge about their health & well-being, only relied on information gathered through reading online, joining forums, or visiting their physicians. While these sources are great to educate women, they’re missing a key point that women need in order to understand their bodies on a daily—biofeedback.When creating Ivy and combing it with our personalized programs and cycle input, we wanted to give women the tools they need to understand their bodies every day, receive actionable advice, and see the change for themselves. By delivering timely and appropriate guidance adjusted to the different stages of the menstrual cycle, every individual user’s unique bio-responses, and lifestyle tracked through sensor technology, we’re introducing women to a way of life that is in sync with their natural hormonal rhythm. A way that leads to a healthier lifestyle and a healthier future where women start working with their bodies instead of against them to achieve their wellness goals.

question_answers.question: What is your long-term vision? If you truly succeed, what will be different about the world?
question_answers.answer: Our long-term vision is to revolutionize the understanding of women's cycle and wellness to empower them to live their full potential. By providing personalized guidance through our subscription option, we aim to bring a new perspective to women's health and wellness that goes beyond traditional approaches. Our goal is to become the leading femtech company in the world and help women lead healthier, better, and more equitable lives.

### 🔨 Why We Built This

# We're Getting Into the GLP Game — But Not With a Me-Too Product

30 million Americans are currently on GLP drugs. That number is going up. Access is getting easier, prices are falling, and the longevity research on low-dose GLP therapy is compelling enough that it's not hard to imagine most adults cycling on and off these medications eventually, not just for weight loss, but for metabolic health and lifespan.

There are plenty of places to buy Ozempic, but the monitoring and optimization infrastructure is not there yet. The biology of GLP therapy is more complicated than the weight loss headline suggests:

🚫 **Muscle loss is hidden by the scale.** Fast weight loss often means lean mass loss, not just fat. Standard weight tracking can't tell the difference.

🚫 **Side effects are downstream signals.** Fatigue, brain fog, hair shedding, and constipation aren't random — they're often markers of caloric under-fueling, nutrient depletion, or dehydration pressure that bloodwork would catch early.

🚫 **Prescribers don't monitor the full picture.** Most GLP patients get minimal follow-up labs, if any. HbA1c, ApoB, ferritin, B12, testosterone, thyroid — none of these are standard-of-care during treatment.

🚫 **Weight alone is a bad success metric.** Losing 24 lbs while losing 6 lbs of muscle and depleting your ferritin is not the same as losing 24 lbs of fat.

# The Solution: A Monitoring Loop Built for GLP Therapy

We've served 50,000+ users with at-home blood testing. GLP users are a distinct population with distinct needs, so we built a product specifically for them. The SiPhox GLP Monitoring Panel connects labs, body composition, and symptom tracking into one continuous loop so you can see what the drug is actually doing to your biology and course-correct before small problems become bigger ones.

---

### 💡 What You Get

**✅ 40+ Lab Markers — GLP-Specific Panel**

Not a generic wellness panel. Built around the markers that matter when appetite, weight, hydration, and body composition are actively changing:

* **Metabolism:** HbA1c, eAG, C-Peptide
* **Lipids & heart:** ApoB, LDL, HDL, Triglycerides, hsCRP
* **Liver:** ALT, AST, ALP, bilirubin, albumin
* **Kidney & hydration:** BUN, creatinine, eGFR, BUN:Cr ratio
* **Thyroid:** TSH, Free T4
* **Hormones:** Testosterone (total + free + %), SHBG, cortisol
* **Nutrition:** Vitamin D, B12, folate, ferritin, iron studies (Iron, UIBC, TIBC, Iron Saturation), total protein

**✅ Painless At-Home Collection**

Collected via our Easydraw arm patch, no venous draw, no finger prick, no lab visit. Mail it back, and the results appear in your dashboard.

**✅ Body-Composition Scanning**

In-app scanner tracks fat loss vs. lean mass preservation between tests.

**✅ GLP Tolerance Score**

A composite score built from labs, body comp, and symptom check-ins. Tracks how well your body is handling therapy at each stage: baseline → titration → maintenance.

**✅ Symptom & Side-Effect Tracking**

Track fatigue, brain fog, hair shedding, GI issues, and muscle soreness between tests. Connects subjective experience to objective lab data.

**✅ Detailed Analysis & Personalized Insights**

Interpret what's moving in the right direction, what deserves a conversation with your prescriber, and what to adjust in diet, training, or supplementation built around your specific results.

GLP drugs are the fastest-growing drug class in history. Next-gen peptides like retatrutide, orforglipron, cagrilintide are coming. The longevity use case is expanding the addressable population well beyond obesity treatment. And monitoring has not kept pace with any of it.

Most patients are flying blind. Prescribers don't have the bandwidth for individualized follow-up. Labs are ordered inconsistently, if at all. No one is connecting weight, body composition, symptoms, and biomarkers in a single continuous view.

Big claim. Maybe _too_ big.

Something more practical: AI + friction-free diagnostics can wipe out **a significant portion of preventable disease** if we give people the right tools.

That’s exactly what we’re shipping an early version of **today**.

---

### **What’s new**

# 1. **Cursor-style Copilot for Your Labs (Beta)**

Upload any lab report—PDF, photo, whatever—and **Sai**, our GPT-powered assistant, appears as a cursor-style sidebar in your dashboard.

Ask it anything:

  ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=90232&key=user_uploads/520037/c7d623a3-5648-489a-a0db-2d8b4b0e55d1)


# 3. **Integrated Expert Review**

Every report is reviewed by health experts. Insights come from a proprietary database developed by SiPhox experts and clinical advisors based on years of longitudinal testing by thousands of users. You still get human nuance + the flexibility of discussing your results with Sai.

# 4. **Free Biological-Age & Heart-Age Scores**

Because a comprehensive dashboard is nice, but **north-star metrics** make it easier to take action and track progress. We built these scores using proprietary models based on public datasets and years of SiPhox user data.

# 5. **Open Uploads**

Not ready to buy a kit? Start by dumping old Quest/Labcorp PDFs into the dashboard for **free**. We’ve had this feature available for a few months now, and uploads are growing exponentially.

---

### **One More Thing 🫀**

# **Heart & Metabolic Program** (launched quietly six months ago, now public)

* **Most complete at-home panel** for cardiometabolic risk (advanced lipids + insulin resistance markers).
* **Phenotype scoring** that fuses glucose-metabolism and lipid data
* American Heart Association risk score and SiPhox **Heart-Age** score so you (and your doctor) can see your heart health status at a glance.
* Access to titrated **lipid-lowering medications** when needed via telemedicine
* Full Sai access, of course.

---

### **Why We’re Doing This**

* **Doctors are time-constrained**. They glance at your test results and say “looks normal” even though “normal” ranges are based on lack of active disease, not disease prevention
* **Patients are guessing**. Reddit threads and WebMD are too generic
* **AI is finally good enough** to translate raw biomarker data into clear, day-to-day actions.
* **Existing doctor-AI tools** are focused on symptom analysis and diagnosis, not on labs and long-term disease prevention
* **60% of Americans have a chronic disease.** We want to help these people manage or even reverse their conditions and help the other 40% stay healthy long into old age.

### **“There’s a new AI agent/chatbot launching every day. Why does the world need another one?”**

1. It’s 100% true that anyone can upload their lab results to ChatGPT or another LLM interface and have a passable conversation about them. Based on our real-world experience with the SiPhox user-base, having a single health dashboard where all of your health data lives makes all the difference. **It’s the same reason Cursor is more useful for coding than ChatGPT…** the assistant in the IDE and has all the necessary context to collaborate with the user. This is something we wanted to experiment with (and we are looking to get as much feedback as possible on the UI).
2. ChatGPT and other chatbots do great on generic medical exams but just like a typical primary care physician, they are less trained to handle health optimization and advanced bloodwork. Selecting “deep research” gives better results, but the output still requires an expert to confirm.
3. SiPhox customized Sai using years of experience repeatedly testing, and coaching tens of thousands of users. This kind of dataset of frequent, comprehensive testing and coaching doesn’t exist publicly (or privately, as far as we know) for LLMs to train on.
4. We are not an AI company building in a vacuum; we are a hardware and clinical product company building, integrating AI to serve the needs of active users who partner with us every day to improve their health.

**Transparently, we are not convinced that this form factor (a chatbot)** is the final iteration, but given the state of AI today (latency vs. accuracy and intelligence tradeoffs), this is where we are starting.

---

### [TALK TO SAI](https://siphoxhealth.com/try-sai)

1. **Don’t forget to upload past labs** → your data and trends are analyzed and displayed in a clear dashboard with the Sai sidebar\_: [https://siphoxhealth.com/try-sai](https://siphoxhealth.com/try-sai%5C)

---

Ten years to cure all diseases is optimistic, but giving everyone a personal lab analyst today is how we start making progress.

See you in the dashboard,

The SiPhox Health team

SiPhox does not sell or share your personal data. SiPhox maintains compliance with industry grade security and best data privacy standards.

Sai is an AI-powered assistant (Beta) developed by SiPhox to provide general informational and educational responses based on its training data. # **The Problem: Blood Testing Is Stuck in the Past**

We live in a world where wearables track heart rate, sleep, and glucose 24/7, yet blood testing—the most critical health data source—is still:

🚫 **Infrequent** – Most people only test once per year at a doctor's visit.

🚫 **Incomplete** – Many key biomarkers are not tested until symptoms appear.

🚫 **Inconvenient** – Booking an appointment, traveling to a lab, and waiting weeks for results is a hassle.

🚫 **Painful** – Finger pricks and venous blood draws deter regular tracking.

🚫 **Fragmented** – No easy way to combine biomarker data with wearables or look at trends in past blood test data.

Meanwhile, people want more and better **insights into their health**, whether for **longevity, athletic performance, metabolic health, hormonal balance, chronic disease prevention, or chronic disease management.**

# **The Solution: Convenient Biomarker Tracking + Personalized Health Insights**

🔬 We spent the last **2.5 years** **experimenting** with at-home blood test kit offerings to solve this problem and **tested tens of thousands of people**.

With the **SiPhox Health Ultimate Program**, we brought blood biomarker tracking, painless home sample collection, advanced biomarkers, personalized insights, body composition, and wearable integration into one seamless platform—so you can take control of your health without paperwork, clinics, finger pricks, or expensive lab tests.

Trying to understand your blood test results shouldn't be a confusing or frustrating experience. If you're lucky enough to discuss the results with your doctor, you might gain some clarity and a prescription, but you’re unlikely to fully understand the status of your body, and feel like you have a clear plan to improve your health.

What's more, as long as your results aren't drastically abnormal, you might not receive any feedback from your doctor at all. This can lead to the neglect of critical signals—issues that may only become apparent when they escalate, often surfacing only a year later in your next annual blood test.

launches.body:
### **The Chronic illness crisis - Now or Never❌**

A chronic condition is a long-term health issue like diabetes, Arthritis, etc.. that doesn’t have a complete cure. The only way to deal with them is to cultivate sustainable dietary and lifestyle habits.

Chronic conditions have always been on the rise due to changing lifestyles, dietary habits, and environmental factors. The COVID-19 pandemic has only served to intensify this alarming trend, catapulting it to new heights.

To put it in perspective, Today more than **70%** of the adult population in the US report having one or more long-term health conditions that impact their quality of life and this number is rising.\
\
_Chronic illnesses account for **75% of all healthcare expenses** in the US._

Although genetics play a role, most chronic illnesses are influenced by social determinants of health, such as sleep, diet, fitness, and stress. The power to make a difference lies largely with the individual.

In order to solve this problem, we need to shift the agency. So far the agents of healthcare have been doctors, nurses, and paramedics and the venue of healthcare has been hospitals and clinics and this needs to shift. app_answers.question: What is your company going to make? Please describe your product and what it does or will do.
app_answers.answer:
SFA Therapeutics, Inc is a biotech with a novel immunomodulatory platform that is focused on the intersection of NF-kB and Ras in the treatment of chronic inflammatory diseases and oncogenesis (the onset of cancer), respectively.

Our vision is to change the practice of Medicine by treating chronic inflammatory conditions that result in cancer, such as hepatitis, which progresses to liver cancer, and pancreatitis, which progresses to pancreatic cancer, by blocking the primary inflammatory pathways with our discoveries..

SFA is developing small molecule drugs originally derived from human GI bacterial metabolites, which have been shown to modulate the immune system through a complex cascade that affects several important molecular pathways, ultimately downregulating NF-kB and RAS, which control involved in inflammation and carcinogenesis. This platform has led to the development of six drugs to treat immuno-inflammatory diseases, using psoriasis as a proof-of concept for autoimmune diseases and chronic liver diseases that are caused by inflammation, including Hepatitis B virus-mediated chronic liver disease, NASH and Hepatocellular Carcinoma (HCC), the most common form of liver cancer. SFA’s two most advanced assets are SFA001 and SFA002, for liver disease and autoimmune diseases, respectively.  SFA002 has an approved IND and is ready to enter into clinical trials in patients.

Our plan is to develop these drugs through phase 2 and create phase 3-ready assets, to license to pharma and biotech partners, in exchange for license fees, royalties and milestone payments.

launches.title: LifestyleRx - Virtual care for Type 2 Diabetes reversal
launches.tagline: We help patients make lifestyle changes to reverse Type 2 Diabetes, covered by existing health insurance
launches.body:
**tl:dr;** LifestyleRx provides virtual care for Type 2 diabetes reversal.  Our doctors guide patients through lifestyle changes to reverse the underlying process of diabetes, billing insurance so we can deliver life-changing outcomes at little or no cost to the patient.  We have 2,000 patients in our program today and are adding 500 more every month.

 

We’re Dan, Brendan, Jason, and Jack, the cofounders of [LifestyleRx](https://lifestylerx.io)!

 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73770&key=user_uploads/1247082/8009148c-572c-4884-b57d-90dc452a5111)

 

We are all former health tech founders who previously built and exited EMR businesses in Canada.  We’re united by our passion for helping diabetic patients as we all have close family who are diabetic.  And we’re also rooted in a real-world understanding of the complex healthcare system, warts and all, from our years working in it.

 

### **Another Diabetes Startup?**

The market is full of employer-facing diabetes management apps that haven’t worked. Diabetes costs more than $237B in direct medical expenses every year, and there are >100M Americans with either prediabetes or Type 2 diabetes.

The solution to this problem needs two things:

1. A focus on diabetes reversal, where sustained drug-free remission is the goal.  Lots of apps reduce diabetes costs by \~5%.  We aim for 95%.
2. Use the healthcare system we have – bill fee-for-service, accept patient referrals, be covered for everyone with insurance – and build a lean operation to power it.

 

We’re building a modern virtual care provider that can meet this need, combining the best of compassionate physician care with infinitely scalable technology to fit profitably into the real world of insurance reimbursement. 

  

### **46% of Patients Reach the Remission Range**

Today we have 2,000 patients in our program, and we deliver 46% of them into the A1C range for diabetic remission – that is, the lab range for someone without diabetes.  This adds years to their lives, offsets hundreds of thousands in lifetime healthcare costs, and significantly reduces the risk of heart disease and cognitive decline.

![timeline](https://media.licdn.com/dms/image/D5622AQFdJxzZM_nMjA/feedshare-shrink_2048_1536/0/1687880971696?e=1694044800&v=beta&t=ofkErOL_pd8t3nbIqMHPtP0_zGCuKCzHaOntjhNkubA)

 

### **Doing It Profitably**

The key to making all of this work is provider leverage.  We make technology that gives our doctors superpowers.  They can complete documentation in a fraction of the time of their peers (<20%) and handle group medical sessions with ease (one of the best-reimbursed services in healthcare because it’s usually so arduous).

We built our own EMR platform, connecting every decision physicians make to real patient data – including readiness-for-change, behavioral momentum, and more.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73770&key=user_uploads/1247082/631140dd-4176-432a-a0dc-e736b9d078e4)

 

Our patients spend only a couple of hours with physicians but have more than 20x hours of connection with their physicians – as they learn through personalized content, understand their disease through interactive reports that contextualize their data, and work step-by-step through implementing their recommended lifestyle changes.  In the future we will leverage LLMs to answer patient questions and guide them through changes, further increasing this provider leverage ratio.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=73770&key=user_uploads/1247082/a6e571be-d442-4c12-a901-97437813c98b)

 

 

### **We’re going to shrink this market**

Diabetes is a $237B market in the US.  Diabetes reversal and maintenance will be a $36B market.  For every $1 spent on diabetes reversal, we offset $15 spent on diabetes care.  And that’s great because the healthcare system needs those dollars for other things.

Type 2 diabetes is just the beginning, as lifestyle medicine can also transform costs across a range of cardiometabolic diseases.  LifestyleRx is the lifestyle prescription for those diseases, and we intend to build a solution that can scale to the size of this vast problem.

launches.title: Sero AI - help humans keep humans safe online
launches.tagline: We help maximize the efficiency and precision of Trust and Safety moderation.
launches.body:
**tl;dr:** [Sero AI](https://www.getsero.ai) streamlines the management of safety workflows, such as abuse reports, content moderation, user appeals, and more. It's a workflow manager, augmented with an AI-copilot, designed to elevate the efficiency and precision of human moderators.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=72896&key=user_uploads/1263379/2a698855-bd77-41ae-9bf8-4f1ab964ffc3)

Hi everyone, we are Talha and Ankur (left to right), and we are building Sero AI. Our mission is to empower platforms to keep their users safe. 

\
We led safety machine learning teams at Meta and Roblox where we deployed hundreds of AI models to safeguard our users from threats like human trafficking and child endangerment. In this process, we learned the often overlooked yet critical importance of human moderation accuracy for enhancing machine learning enforcement. Inspired by this understanding, we founded Sero AI with the goal to support other companies navigating similar Trust and Safety challenges.

### **🧨 The Problem**

Platforms hosting user-generated content establish community guidelines and employ a substantial workforce of human moderators. Their role is crucial in enforcing these policies, particularly high risk policies such as child endangerment, hate speech, and harassment. At a large scale, Trust and Safety operations managers face challenges in ensuring moderator quality and consistency. Thus platforms either build in-house bespoke solutions or use non-opinionated tools such as  Zendesk, which leads to high costs, user frustrations, and safety risks. This costs tens of millions of dollars, over-enforces account bans, and causes real life harm.

### **✨ Our Solution**

We provide an end to end solution for T&S operations management and moderation. Sero AI is the fastest way to set up tailored safety workflows and customize review user interfaces, augmented by a self learning AI-copilot to assist human moderators.

* Easily setup moderation workflows:create tailored moderation workflows such as tiered child safety reviews or a user appeals queue. All in a few clicks.
* Customize moderation UI: Build custom views with all relevant information in one place. No more jumping across several screens to review a single user.
* Moderate with AI co-pilot: Accelerate reviews of users, audios, and videos by highlighting harmful sections.

As Salesforce manages customer relations, Sero AI streamlines Trust and Safety operations.

### **🙏 Our Asks**

Introduce us to your Trust and Safety friends.

We’re excited to introduce [Flex Market](https://www.withflex.com/shop), a new marketplace designed to make health and wellness more accessible.

Here’s a glimpse of what you’ll find on Flex Market:

* **🏋️‍♀️** Fitness programs and equipment
* 🧴 Supplements 
* 💆‍♀️ Sleep and recovery products
* ⌚ Wearables 
* 🏥 Traditional OTC health products (eyeglasses, women’s health products etc)

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86397&key=user_uploads/6343/178a211a-9313-4e35-af74-717bc445d4ed)

**Why Flex Market is Unique**

For products like supplements, fitness equipment or other “dual use” items, consumers are required to have a doctor's note, or Letter of Medical Necessity (LMN), to qualify to spend their HSA/FSA funds. 

Flex is the only place where consumers can both shop for traditional healthcare products (think what you might expect to find at a CVS) as well as those items that require a Letter of Medical Necessity (LMN). For those that require the latter, consumers can initiate a two minute telehealth consultation immediately, qualify, and receive their LMNs later that day.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=86397&key=user_uploads/6343/67901886-4948-4208-807e-b72e1d912ecc)

**Quick HSA/FSA Background**

Health Savings Accounts and Flexible Spending Accounts are tax advantaged accounts that are designated to be spent on healthcare related purchases. Historically these funds have only been able to be spent on trips to the doctor’s office or buying items at CVS. 

FSAs are use-it-or-lose-it, meaning that at the end of the year any funds that aren't spent are forfeited. On average, individuals lose about $450 per year, resulting in nearly $10B of lost benefits.

**Why it Matters**

Flex Market isn’t just a shopping platform – it’s part of a larger mission to make health and wellness more accessible.

By addressing the barriers of traditional HSA/FSA spending, we’re helping people:

* Avoid forfeiting their hard-earned HSA/FSA funds
* Discover new ways to invest in their health
* Making health products and services more accessible

**Check Us Out Today!**

If you or someone you know has FSA funds to spend before year-end or is gearing up for health-related purchases as part of a New Year’s resolution, check out [Flex Market!](https://www.withflex.com/shop) If you’re interested in seeing your brand on the marketplace, reach out to us [here.](https://www.withflex.com/contact)

Thanks so much for your support – and here’s to a healthier 2025! 💪

**PROBLEM**

Today, HSA/FSAs can only be spent at medical institutions or large retailers that have specific inventory management systems in place to comply with IRS regulations.

As a result many consumer wellness, fitness, nutrition, and even e-commerce companies selling health related products are not able to accept HSA/FSAs. 

These businesses are missing out on 60M American consumers who are looking to spend $120B per year from their HSA/FSA accounts on health related products and services.

**SOLUTION**

Flex is a payment platform for businesses to accept HSA/FSA cards. 

We provide a prebuilt, hosted checkout page or UI building blocks to integrate HSA/FSA payments directly into your existing payments flow. 

We know how critical your checkout flow is so Flex pages are thoughtfully designed to optimize conversion.

**HOW IT WORKS**

For [pre-approved items by the IRS](https://www.irs.gov/publications/p502#en_US_2022_pu): Flex checks your inventory against the most up to date IRS approved products list and it processes the FSA or HSA payment, and keeps the necessary records in the case of an audit.

For non-pre-approved items: Flex’s asynchronous telehealth team assesses medical necessity and can issue the required paperwork to make your product or service HSA/FSA eligible for the customer — all in a streamlined checkout flow.

**TEAM**

We’re Sam and Miguel! We met working together at a growth stage at fintech company, Unit21. We’re both lifelong athletes, and started Flex because we believe we can improve people’s lives by making healthy habits more accessible.

_HSAs (Health Savings Account) and FSAs (Flexible Savings Accounts) are accounts that allow you to set aside pre-tax money to spend on health related purchases. Since you aren't being taxed on the money you put into the account, anything you spend it on is effectively \~30% cheaper._

Ambitious students are underserved. A hungry high schooler is capable of so much more than APs and creating fake non-profits to get into a college.\

AI will make the top performers produce a larger and larger proportion of human work. We will help create this next generation of top performers from the most ambitious students of today.\

### The Team:

Shivani and Hamza worked together at SpaceX on the Starlink Software team. \
\
**Shivani:** \
Shivani was the first software engineer on the Starlink customer support team. She built all the AI support software tooling from scratch as a solo-engineer. She built the Starlink app/web chatbots, an AI copilot for internal teams and support agents, a telemetry enabled root causing system, and much more! She helped take AI automation at Starlink from 0 to 70%. \
\
**Hamza:** \
Hamza built internal tooling to manage Starlink’s multi-billion dollar ecommerce flow and solved global customer issues. He built the internal localization framework, payments infrastructure, SEO, content management, and much more

### The Problem:

For hardware products, post-sales support is more than just replying to emails and working tickets. **50-80% of customer issues are tightly coupled with what is happening on devices.** Resolutions require in person service, warranty checks, returns & replacements (RMAs), video calls, and root-causing defective hardware.

launches.body:
**Hey everyone 👋!** We’re [Pari](https://www.linkedin.com/in/paridhilatawa/), [Frank](https://www.linkedin.com/in/frank-lee-/), and [Jin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jinwong01/), co-founders of Illume. 

**TL;DR:** Illume is a 24/7 personal health companion that connects your wearables, nutrition, workouts, and lab results to give you personalized, actionable insights over text. 

**Join our private beta waitlist: [www.illumelabs.ai](http://www.illumelabs.ai). \
Watch Our [Launch Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bsfFOzB0Nho):**

**Problem:** 

Health data is more abundant than ever, but it remains scattered. Nearly six in ten U.S. adults own a wearable or connected health device, and nearly one in three used an AI chatbot for health questions. People are generating more health data than ever and actively looking for help understanding it, but their data and guidance still live in separate places. 

We saw this firsthand as family members struggled to piece together glucose readings for diabetes and blood tests for cardiovascular risk, all while juggling a pile of fitness, nutrition, and health-tracking apps that never talked to each other. 

People increasingly turn to ChatGPT or Claude for answers, but without continuous context to their health, the advice is often generic, incomplete, and difficult to track over time.

**Our solution:** 

Illume creates one home for your health and gives you a personal health companion you can text. 

Today, you can: 

* Connect your wearable and automatically sync sleep, activity, and recovery data 
* Text Illume photos of your meals to log and understand your nutrition 
* Record workouts and track your training 
* Upload bloodwork and lab results 
* Ask questions about your health using the context of your own data 
* Receive proactive insights about what changed, what it might mean, and what to do next

For example, you can ask: 

* “Why am I so exhausted today? Make me a dashboard of all the relevant metrics!” 
* “How has eating late affected my sleep?”
* “Am I recovering well enough to train? Run a regression!”
* “What should I focus on before my next blood test?”

Illume connects patterns across your data that individual platforms can’t see, giving you a more complete picture of your health instead of another isolated score or dashboard. 

You can text your Illume agent for quick answers or use the platform to explore your data, trends, and history in greater depth.

**Our mission**

Our long-term vision is to make healthcare more proactive, continuous, and personalized. 

By combining continuous biometrics with nutrition, training, blood panels, and eventually genetic risk, Illume could help surface meaningful changes earlier and help people understand their susceptibility to conditions such as cardiovascular disease, diabetes, and Alzheimer’s. 

We want to help people move from asking, “What happened?” to understanding what may be changing and what they can do about it. 

**Who’s it for:** Illume is initially designed for people who are proactive about their health and longevity- especially lifters, biohackers, and anyone already using wearables, blood panels, CGMs, nutrition trackers, or genetic testing.  

**Who we are:** We’re three MIT graduates who met in freshman year! 

[Pari Latawa](https://www.linkedin.com/in/paridhilatawa/): MIT BS & MEng in CS + Molecular Biology. Previously conducted research at the Broad Institute, Eli Lilly, & MD Anderson. Founded EasyComm to build tools for children with Down Syndrome, and SparkED, a health-literacy nonprofit.

[Frank Lee](https://www.linkedin.com/in/frank-lee-/): MIT BS in Computer Science and Mathematics. Conducted RLAIF research for language models at MIT CSAIL and previously built agent systems at Windsurf.

[Jin Wong](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jinwong01/): MIT BS in Business Analytics. Previously conducted research at the MIT Media Lab and deployed coding agents at Windsurf. 

**Our ask:** 

**Join the private beta waitlist at [www.illumelabs.ai](http://www.illumelabs.ai).** We’ll invite an initial group of founding members to receive early access and help shape the product. 

**If you want to chat or can intro us** to someone in training, sports, longevity, and/or biohacking, email us at [founders@illumelabs.ai](mailto:founders@illumelabs.ai). We’d love to stop by, chat, and show you how Illume works!

launches.body:
# TL;DR: We’ve created the last probiotic you’ll ever need - personalised, constantly improving, while also generating valuable data.

### 

# What we do and why

Your gut is the most unique part of your body, different enough that the same probiotic can work for one person and do nothing for another. Most probiotics disappoint because they’re one formula for everyone, and in any gut most of their strains never establish. GutGutGoose makes a probiotic that won’t work for any gut but yours: we sequence your microbiome, find which strains can establish in the microbes you already have, compound those into your formula, and re-sequence you weeks later to confirm they took hold.

It’s for people who’ve tried things for IBS, bloating, digestion, mood, weight or GLP-1 symptoms without luck. If it doesn’t work you get your money back, and retesting shows how your gut changed, so you know it’s not a placebo.\
\
<https://youtu.be/Cn6oGduZosc>

The innovation is accurately predicting which bacteria will live in a gut, which is extremely hard. It’s built on two peer-reviewed models, MICOM and AGORA2, and more than 7,000 metabolic reconstructions of gut bacteria, and it finds the strains that can hold in your gut’s community. On two published human cohorts, its predictions matched what actually established 84.7% and 76.7% of the time, and we reproduced the first at 78.1% ourselves. Off-the-shelf products manage under 5%. Once we can control which bacteria live where, we can run precision interventions in the gut and engineer it.

We’re a supplement today and can’t treat disease, but each cycle produces a record of one gut, one intervention, and the result. That record makes each customer’s next formula better, and across thousands of people it becomes the first longitudinal dataset of the human gut responding to known, controlled changes. Our vision is to use changes in metabolic pathways over time to predict Alzheimer’s, dementia and Parkinson’s a decade before symptoms appear.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=108277&key=user_uploads/991771/50caffe3-e0c9-44e5-9212-da1bbabc0e00)

# Traction

We gave a talk at an endometriosis event, and 20 of the 50 people joined our waitlist. The first night we opened paid deposits, we called five people from that list at 7:30pm. Three picked up, and we managed to get seven sign ups, they were so excited they referred and paid for their families that night. Five of the 20 referred someone else, and our traction has only grown since.

# Team

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=108277&key=user_uploads/991771/13686614-1a12-4b14-a657-d33d042b3ee6)

The GutGutGoose founders winning the YC product pitch

Leon started university at 14 and spent four years at a $3bn YC unicorn. After we started GutGutGoose, he built a pharmacy, now doing $4M a year, to fund the science behind our engine. Anis joined in September; he co-built the model, runs operations, and is the youngest ever to win Queensland’s Math Olympiad. He’s on a Chancellor’s Excellence Scholarship in AI and Data Science, and (fun fact) was once the world’s number one Catan player.

Hey YC! We're Alfredo and Ranad, the founders of Omanta.

**TL;DR: Omanta creates a personalized research lab around a single patient. We integrate a patient’s complete medical record, personal genomics, and use AI to take on the most complex cancer cases. Our researchers tackled GitLab co-founder Sid Sijbrandij’s case, helping bring him into complete remission.**

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EkZaq_fENqI>

\
**Why this matters**\
If you're a cancer patient, you'd think the hardest cases have entire teams dedicated to solving them. The reality: most doctors have about 20 minutes per patient, while the science never stops moving. New discoveries emerge every day, yet reaching standard clinical care can take over a decade (\~17 years on average). Physicians make high-stakes decisions with limited time, and even the most difficult cases rarely have anyone whose full-time job is to interrogate every layer of that one patient's disease and push the newest science toward their treatment.

That's the gap we built Omanta to close.\
\
**What we do**\
We meet patients wherever they are in their journey. We integrate their complete medical record and personal genomics with AI and clinical evidence to understand the molecular drivers of their disease. Then we map every existing therapy against their biology, and if the right therapy doesn't exist, we build it, from cancer vaccines and immunotherapies to highly targeted radioligand therapies.\
\
We've worked on some of the most complex cancer cases in the world. Most notably, **Alfredo was the genomics lead for the personalized therapeutic campaign behind GitLab founder Sid Sijbrandij's complete remission**, partnering with leading institutions to pursue personalized mRNA/DNA vaccines, CAR-T programs, drug repurposing, expanded-access therapies, and continuous molecular monitoring. We've seen what becomes possible when the full force of modern science is organized around a single person, and Omanta brings that depth of investigation to every case.\
\
**Why us**\
We met eight years ago working on early CRISPR cancer research and have been building toward this ever since.

* **Alfredo Gonzalez, PhD (CEO)** — translational genomics. Led the year-long investigation of 25TB of sequencing and molecular data for Sid Sijbrandij, key missing information in existing genomic reports, and uncovered actionable findings that reshaped his therapeutic strategy, including personalized mRNA/DNA vaccines, CAR-T, expanded access, drug repurposing, and continuous monitoring. PhD at UCLA, where he built one of the world's largest centralized multi-omic datasets for rare tumors. Previously at the Broad Institute (Cancer Dependency Map, validating targets from large-scale CRISPR screens) and Harvard's Wagers Lab.

Earned her PhD in Chemical Biology from Harvard in three years, where she identified a druggable mechanism in ulcerative colitis that became the basis of a multimillion-dollar GSK collaboration. Built and directed a multimillion-dollar scientific program centered on a single rare-cancer patient, then went on to direct scientific strategy for 12+ medically complex patients after standard options were exhausted. At the Broad, she co-created and co-led a fellowship turning scientific discoveries into companies.

# Lumeria is the Oura Ring for Skin:

TLDR: Lumeria is the Oura Ring for Skin: the Lumoscope clips onto your phone, scans your skin with the same multispectral light used in clinics, and Lumi, your AI skin coach, reads that history to personalize recommendations for you, so your routine is built on your data instead of someone else's.

Preorders are open at the $199 founding price until **August 16. After that, the price only goes up**. <https://lumeria.skin> 

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W-tz9FIQiOg>

## ❌ The problem

Anthea’s sister spent eight years chasing her eczema.

The cause turned out to be dust in the carpet.

No one caught it because no one was recording anything. Her skin was reacting to her sleep, her home, her products, the air around her, and none of it existed as data. Every dermatologist that took months to see started from zero. Every product she tried was a guess.

That is the **$190B** skincare industry in one story. It runs on guessing.

Lumeria ends that: it captures the missing data layer that gives you the power to understand and own your skin's health data, from home.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=109979&key=user_uploads/3470868/08058377-6a96-414b-b03e-44ff36f8622a)

## 🔬 How it works

The Lumoscope shrinks the multi-spectrum imaging dermatology clinics use into a clip for your phone. Press it against your skin and see yourself in three kinds of light: true color (RGB), UV, and cross-polarized.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=109979&key=user_uploads/3470868/76776eef-52f9-4416-827c-36c74760f8dd)

For the first time, you see what your mirror can't: a breakout building days before it surfaces, sun damage hiding under flawless-looking skin, where inflammation is building up.

Each scan becomes an objective read (hydration, redness, evenness, pigmentation, texture, pores) plus a score out of 100 and a skin age, so you can understand your progress.

Track them over time, and Lumi tells you exactly what to do. 

* It finds the cause, linking your breakouts to habits you'd never think of, from your sleep to your cycle to the pillowcase you forgot to wash. 
* It recommends products from a database of 18000+ products + ingredients, matched to what your scans actually show works.
* It hands your dermatologist 90 days of images, trends, and context in one tap.
* And it compounds: every scan adds to a history and increased understanding of your skin’s relevant context.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=109979&key=user_uploads/3470868/c36570ca-4042-47bc-beb4-5f1a27014d6a)

 It works across every skin tone. It is private and encrypted by default. 

## 👥 Why we built this

Anthea, our CTO, lived with this problem: suffering from eczema that would not heal, five months to reach a dermatologist, four misdiagnoses. She is an engineer who worked on computational biology at Google and Boehringer Ingelheim. Maryanne, our CEO, is a skincare creator with 25M+ views across her UGC portfolio, exited her first biotech company by 19, and still could not explain her own breakouts until Lumeria. We understand the helplessness people feel with their skin, so we built what was needed.

We are patent pending, shipping in Fall 2026, and built on 150+ interviews and 2 clinical partnerships with dermatologists and patients.
